---
name: Bug report
about: Something computes wrong, renders wrong, or breaks
labels: bug
---

**Page**

Which page or tab (calculator, week, investments, member grade, data)?

**What I did**

The exact input or steps. If it is a wrong number, include the exact dates
or series so a test can be written from this report.

**What I expected**

**What happened instead**

**Where**

Browser and device (for example: Chrome 140 on Windows 11, or iPhone
Safari). Mention whether it happened on the live site or a local dev build.

**Screenshots**

If you have them, attach them. A picture of a wrong number beats a
description of it.
